   FROM maintenance_hour_results h

           FROM maintenance_nonroutine_role_results r
          WHERE (r.result_id = h.id))))
UNION ALL
 SELECT r.id,
    h.owner_type,

    h.flight_id,
    r.source_assignment_id AS assignment_id,

    r.created_at,
    h.updated_at
   FROM (maintenance_nonroutine_role_results r

UNION ALL

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_capability_current_states_person_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$ begin if not exists(select 1 from personnel p where p.id=new.person_id and p.data_status='active' and p.employment_status not in ('离职','停职')) and not exists(select 1 from capability_current_states where person_id=new.person_id) then raise exception '人员不存在或已失效，不能写入能力状态'; end if; return new; end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_capability_deployment_location()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$ begin if (new.kind='DEPLOYED' and (new.deployment_location_id is null or not exists(select 1 from capability_deployment_locations location where location.id=new.deployment_location_id and location.workspace=new.workspace))) or (new.kind<>'DEPLOYED' and new.deployment_location_id is not null) then raise exception '派驻地点关联无效'; end if; return new; end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_capability_other_status_option()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$ begin if (new.kind='OTHER' and (new.other_status_option_id is null or not exists(select 1 from capability_other_status_options option where option.id=new.other_status_option_id and option.workspace=new.workspace))) or (new.kind<>'OTHER' and new.other_status_option_id is not null) then raise exception '其他状态目录关联无效'; end if; return new; end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_capability_status_records_person_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$ begin if not exists(select 1 from personnel p where p.id=new.person_id and p.data_status='active' and p.employment_status not in ('离职','停职')) then raise exception '人员不存在或已失效，不能写入能力状态'; end if; return new; end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_capability_status_replacement()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$ begin if new.replaces_record_id is not null and (new.kind<>'DEPLOYED' or new.id=new.replaces_record_id or not exists(select 1 from capability_status_records prior where prior.id=new.replaces_record_id and prior.kind='DEPLOYED' and prior.workspace=new.workspace and prior.data_status='active')) then raise exception '派驻交接关系无效'; end if; return new; end $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_capability_supports_person_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$ begin if not exists(select 1 from personnel p where p.id=new.person_id and p.data_status='active' and p.employment_status not in ('离职','停职')) then raise exception '人员不存在或已失效，不能写入能力状态'; end if; return new; end $function$
